name: Liptovský Ondrej (Slovakia)
description: A red field within a yellow border, with a saltire of white edged in yellow, ending at the fly in three tails formed by two swallowtail notches reaching one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature L-37/94.
